title: Rules check the format, the judge checks the content

scenes.text:
5 of 5 posts.
No question.
Judge: pass.
scenes.say: 5 of 5 posts: no open question. The LLM judge passed all 5.
Run on the five posts: the judge passed 5 of 5, the format check flagged 5 of 5.

scenes.note: endings are not in its rubric
scenes.say: The judge was never asked: endings are not in its rubric, and my own rule said no question.
The format check calls no model. One line looks for a question mark in the last two paragraphs.
Its limit, in a toy example: Agree? passes. It sees a question mark, not an open question.

scenes.note: a stale Short, an overstated claim
scenes.say: The judge caught what the rules skip: a Short not re-rendered after a fix, and an overstated claim.

scenes.note: ask the model only about meaning
scenes.say: If it can be counted, check it in code. Ask the model only about meaning.
Part 3 of my AI Engineering notes.
